summary: Assembles a 4-byte big-endian byte array into a single 32-bit integer by shifting each unsigned byte into place. Pure utility with no guards, globals, or calls.

operations.description: Combine the four bytes at a1[0..3] as a big-endian integer: a1[0] is the most significant byte, a1[3] the least significant, via chained left shifts and additions of unsigned byte reads.
